question: Can the actor who last pushed a pull request's head be read as a fact?
pass: Yes (section 6), when an App pushed it (#27): the entry of `GET /repos/{repo}/activity?ref=refs/heads/{head}` whose `after` equals the pull request's `head.sha` names the trial-author App's bot, with `actor.type` Bot.
